history.notes: FireRed Redux Beta v0.2.0: Enhanced Battle UI; mid-battle evolutions; dynamic wild encounter levels; rare evolved encounters; reusable TMs; trainer rematches; progression-based trainer balancing; expanded Trainer Guide; short-code Mystery Gifts; live Discord milestone announcements; battle crash fixes and general gameplay improvements.
Butterfree's secondary typing changed from Flying to Pyschic

Added 32 new Mega Evolutions inspired by official Gigantimax forms, featuring animated sprites, custom stats, abilities, and dedicated Mega Stones. Rebalanced several Mega Evolutions for improved competitive viability. Added a Dynamic Camera toggle in the Options menu, allowing players to disable cinematic camera movement during battles. Improved Mega Evolution sprite positioning and scaling. Various graphical improvements and bug fixes.

notes: Restored automatic directional movement, player spinning, direction changes and yellow stopping pads on B2F and B3F. Corrected a variable mismatch that prevented the original elevator animation and screen shake from executing. Restored the sound triggers and included backup sound effects if the original audio files are missing.
